bibl.title: POxy 2430 fr. 131 (Simon. F 15 Poltera = fr. 519, 131 Page): un epinicio per Astilo?
bibl.seg: Serena Napoleone, POxy 2430 fr. 131 (Simon. F 15 Poltera = fr. 519, 131 Page): un epinicio per Astilo?
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XXV, 2430 (= MP3 1910; LDAB 3913), fr. 131. - The fragment belongs to an epinician ode composed in honour of a runner who could be identified with Astylus, the same addressee as in Simon. F 10 Poltera (= fr. 506 Page).
